notes.title: The Idiot's Tale - Soundtrack, Steam Deck, and Sale, Oh My!
notes.content:
Greets to thee! Remember that time we made a point-and-click adventure game? So do we!

While the game itself remains perfect and in need of absolutely no bugfixes whatsoever, we wanted to let you know about some The Idiot's Tale-adjacent content! Woots all around!


 The official Idiot's Tale soundtrack is now available on Steam! You can download the 16-track masterpiece in MP3 format (or lossless WAV format if you have Very Good Ears (TM)).
 We've tested The Idiot's Tale out on Steam Deck, and it runs beautifully! Now you can take Sir Quest on the go! Play The Idiot's Tale in many exciting locations, such as the grocery store or the post office!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32131671/510996f0a81a001876fbed5d5b847e8fd8c0397e.jpg


 Finally, to celebrate all this Miscellaneous Hubbub, The Idiot's Tale is 33% off for this week only!


That's all! Now scram!
